profile.headline: Engineering at Redo
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Investment Associate
positions.description:
• Supported startups by sourcing deals, evaluating pitches, conducting due diligence, and investing.
• Gained invaluable experience through mentorship from industry-leading venture capitalists.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed full stack web applications using a React frontend with Ruby on Rails, Go, and PostgreSQL for backend services.
• Gained hands-on experience with cloud technologies by deploying applications on AWS, optimizing scalability, and leveraging cloud advantages.
• Actively participated in feature ideation and product discussions, contributing innovative ideas for better product performance and user experiences.
• Found and developed a passion and skill for web programming in a startup environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked as a civilian software engineering intern for the Department of Defense. 
• Utilized Python and C++ to communicate with and control a group of small vehicles remotely.
• Automated the collection, interpretation, and storage of data from various sensors.
• Developed modular programs to integrate various hardware from motors to small computers and designed a focused and efficient user interface.
• Worked on a small team of four and employed Agile practices and Git source code management.
